FAQ

Questions, answered

What is AdversaryAI?

AdversaryAI is an AI sparring partner. You pick a practice mode — debate, job interview, negotiation, and more — then argue your case by voice or by text. The AI pushes back in real time, and when the session ends you get detailed coaching scores on your argument strength, evidence, rebuttals, and composure.

How does a session work?

You choose a mode and a scenario (anything from "AI should be regulated" to a mock interview for a product role), pick your opponent style, and set the difficulty. Then you practice in timed exchanges — make your case, handle rebuttals, and deliver a closing. Afterwards you get a full scorecard showing where you won and lost points.

Do I need a microphone?

No. Voice sessions need a mic, but text sessions work with just a keyboard — same opponents, same scoring. Many people start with text and switch to voice once they're warmed up.

Is there a free trial?

Yes — your first 3 sessions are free, with full access to every practice mode and voice or text. No credit card required to start.

What does it cost after the trial?

Debater is $12/month for 30 sessions, Coach is $29/month for 150 sessions plus coaching analytics, and Champion is $49/month for 25 sessions with our smartest debate brain (DeepSeek V4 Pro). Prefer one-off? Session packs cost $9 for 10, $19 for 25, or $39 for 60 sessions — and pack credits never expire.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Monthly plans cancel in one click and you keep access until the end of your billing period. Any unused pack credits stay on your account — they never expire.
